name: data-store-settings-tab-mwhw8jtk: Three panels (status table, backups, move a namespace)

description: Three panels in order: where the data is (a table of namespaces with mode, keys on axf-data, drift and next step), backups (last backup, verify result, Backup now / Verify), and move a namespace (pick one, then Shadow / Cut over / Roll back with confirm, drift log under it).
